title: Research: exact mixed COPY62 retained-hit obstruction
body:
## Result

Scoped negative result; **no new supplier, κ, or selected-frontier change**.

This independently sampled instance finds a concrete P112 **COPY62** support proposal with nine rank-six star slices and one coordinate rank-eight rectangle. It passes every one of the **1,260 full-frame rank demands** and covers **all112 diagonals**, unlike the homogeneous COPY60 witness in #1347.

Its complete source-bound retained-hit family is nevertheless excluded:

- Complete census: **7,616 tagged rank-seven parents**, **967,232 maximal row slices**.
- Each of the nine new hit patterns has two support representatives; all eight coordinate choices give **4,096 quotient cases**.
- **4,093** fail diagonal coverage.
- The remaining **three** have exact two-root separators: `(2,22)`, `(4,22)`, `(2,23)`. In each case only the coordinate rectangle can contribute, so a rank-one term cannot produce `4 I_2`.
- A separate saturated-frame square-duality certificate also rejects the displayed support proposal.

The written domination argument covers arbitrary joint rank-at-most-six descendants retaining their assigned hits, independent transposition, arbitrary complex coefficients under ordinary transpose, arbitrary subtrimming of the coordinate rectangle, and extra cost-zero terms. **Other COPY62 supports remain open.** Broader solver timeouts are recorded as failures to finish, not impossibility proofs.

## Why this question matters

The fully optimistic mixed profile retains the selected non-centre counts and replaces COPY64 with COPY62. Exact rational intervals give `a` ceiling `[0.001783866218920,0.001783866218921]`, over **5.55%** above the selected-word ceiling. This is a rejection screen only: frame changes, restoration, hosting and precision have not been realized or declared free in a supplier.

This changes #1347's homogeneous rank alphabet and its original ten patterns; it is not the existing 99-diagonal representative result with a larger seed. Credit #1347/#1323 and #1402 (Cinna Davis), the retained `p112-rank6-cover-representatives` package (@woklerx), and the PR1226/1236/1242/717/968 geometry and decoder lineage. The ceiling engine is PR1240's. Prior-round #1909 concerns a different tetrad-local alphabet and is not resubmitted here.

## Verification

Only `research/p112-rank6-hall-obstruction/` changes. Standard-library CPython **3.12.12**, all exercised locally:

```sh
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -B research/p112-rank6-hall-obstruction/verify.py --write
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python -I -O -B research/p112-rank6-hall-obstruction/verify.py
uv run --python 3.12 --no-project python scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-rank6-hall-obstruction
```

All returned:

```text
PASS_P112_MIXED62_QUOTIENT parents=7616 slices=967232 families=4096 diagonal_survivors=3 rank2_rejections=3 controls=9
```

The registered replay also returned `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE ... outcome=negative-result`. The combined three-command phase took12.30s on the recorded host. Positive evidence includes12,544 exact coordinate-decoder entries,10,080 term traces,48 rational square-dual fixtures and an ordinary-transpose complex fixture. The exact scan covers all262,928 orthogonal cliques, including those without live eight-frame extensions.

No full selected-frontier cold replay, native compiler/admission, hosted CI, Lean proof or independent human review is claimed. See `VALIDATION.json`, `CERTIFICATE.json`, `SOURCES.json`, `OVERLAP.json` and the README's precise theorem and open next question.
